# Core AI Agency

> AI agents that answer calls, follow up with leads and book appointments for contractors and local businesses. Also offers AI consulting and one-on-one AI training, in person in Meridian, Idaho or over Zoom.

Based in Meridian, Idaho. Serves the Boise / Treasure Valley area in person and businesses across the US by phone and Zoom.

## Services
- 24/7 AI receptionist and appointment setter
- Missed-call text-back
- Quote requests and intake
- Lead follow-up and reactivation
- Review requests
- Custom AI agents
- AI consulting for business owners
- One-on-one AI training (in person or Zoom)
